method: Manual audit of nine weak, grouped, inventory-missed, or contradictory issue mappings after running build_crosswalk.py. This supplements the 360-row discovery crosswalk; it does not certify those IDs or infer behavior from absence of an exact citation.

priorities.source: EC3 Annex F, F.3.2; physical 899 / printed 884
priorities.crosswalk_signal: Source/disposition candidate in the reviewed Annex F batch. Parent's exact old-version public optimizer regression now reports failing PDF 1.0/1.1 outputs and a passing 1.2 control.
priorities.manual_disposition: Parent's exact old-version public optimizer regression reports PDF 1.0 and 1.1 linearization outputs fail the new minimum-1.2 condition, while the 1.2 control passes. This is a writer conformance finding for the linearization output/version path, not merely an absent test or a reader obligation.
evidence: crates/pdf-transform/src/optimize.rs passes document.version() to the serializer; crates/pdf-syntax/src/serialize.rs::header_version has no 1.2 table-output floor
priorities.residual: Already durably recorded as B55 with two failing public linearizer assertions and a passing1.2 control at checkpoint63. No new failure from the crosswalk.

priorities.source: §13.2.4.2 Table 285 / MH row, physical 637 / printed 622; nearby data-BU paragraph and Tables 287/289
priorities.crosswalk_signal: Promoted source-disposition review at checkpoint63; no unpromoted scratch source is needed.
priorities.manual_disposition: The actual Table 285 mark replaces a Table 287 cross-reference with Table 289. Nearby data-specific prose still places /BU in Table 287, whose semantics differ from Table 289 section offsets. Parent confirmed this is an effective-source inconsistency; the public BU judge tests pass the implementation's clear neighboring BU interpretation. Do not call it a production defect.
evidence: doc/reviews/2038-specification-audit/shards/errata_media_annex_batch_current/findings.txt, D44 and public BU judge result
priorities.residual: Standards-owner clarification is still needed to resolve the conflicting Table 285 reference; current test evidence covers the direct BU prose, not the contradictory reference.

priorities.source: Primary PDF physical 459; subject also marks issue 162
priorities.crosswalk_signal: Literal-only current evidence; missing as a row from the older late issue index even though the annotation subject includes #288.

The replacement explicitly allows optional SD in the PDF2.0 dictionary destination and names action Tables202–204. priorities.source: Annex L attachment annotation, physical 962 / printed 947
priorities.crosswalk_signal: Source-disposition/assertion candidate, but the existing per-issue inventory omits #336 as a later marker in a multi-issue subject.
priorities.manual_disposition: Current Annex L audit preserves attachment hashes and the group #64/#83/#336/#349/#440 replacement context. It explicitly says the #336 matrix-cell changes were not independently mapped cell by cell. Treat this as partial source/attachment evidence, not proof of all corrected relationships.

priorities.crosswalk_signal: The direct primary census sees #48 as a later marker in subjects `Issue #47 and #48`; the old early issue inventory has no #48 row. Current font shards cite the grouped correction.
priorities.manual_disposition: The #47/#48 grouped source correction withdraws the standard-14 availability SHALL premise. ADR 0253 and current font notes conclude this does not require readers to provide every standard-14 font. This is an explicit grouped disposition, not an unreviewed behavior defect; avoid double-counting the shared annotation as two independent edits.
evidence: primary PDF p329–330 subjects include both IDs
priorities.residual: The old issue index is incomplete for this later subject marker; the grouped source disposition is present in current font evidence.

priorities.crosswalk_signal: The direct primary census sees #71 after #45 in the combined subject; the old late issue inventory has no #71 row. A per-issue row exists in current source batch.
priorities.manual_disposition: The current errata structure-metadata row calls this a clarification: a combined caret adds `or both` to the TH description, with no independent new behavior. Its own code_tests field says the relevant assertion bodies still need inspection before claiming test coverage. The source effect is reviewed; assertion strength remains qualified.
evidence: primary PDF p782 combined subject `Issue #45 and #71`
priorities.residual: Inspect the named table grid/header assertion bodies if the project needs a positive behavior-coverage claim; the existing shard explicitly withholds that claim.

priorities.source: Tables 89 and 143, physical 274–275 / printed 259–260 and physical 435–436 / printed 420–421
priorities.crosswalk_signal: Per-issue result row in the numeric-syntax errata batch; the row is coupled to six informative Text notes, not a new decoder rule.
priorities.manual_disposition: The parent corrected the locators and read the actual annotation rectangles: six cross-references target ImageMask/Alternates, SMask/StructParent/ID/OPI restrictions and point to Table 143. The batch explicitly says existing soft-mask tests sample only some rules and do not certify all six. No defect is inferred from the incomplete assertion sample.
priorities.residual: Do not present selected generic mask tests as coverage of all six restrictions; no new unsupported-input rejection requirement was established.

priorities.source: Grouped errata targets at physical 274, 453–454, 855; printed 259, 438–439, 840
priorities.crosswalk_signal: One multi-ID `issues` feature record (shared annotation group); no standalone per-ID test was added.
priorities.manual_disposition: The reference/editorial shard maps #14's image-mask terminology, viewer-preference table references and CropBox spelling, and ties operative preference/print behavior to existing literal-boundary assertions. It states that these sampled assertions are not complete preference/association coverage and that no tests were added or rerun for editorial changes.
priorities.residual: Editorial changes do not warrant a new defect label; retain the shard's bounded coverage limits.

priorities.crosswalk_signal: Issue is present in a rich feature row's `errata` field rather than a numeric `issue` field; direct-key matching correctly classifies a source/disposition/assertion candidate.
priorities.manual_disposition: The annotation-common feature records the corrected Invisible cross-reference and scopes the behavior to unsupported/nonstandard subtypes without a handler. It names implementation and a flag matrix that tests the standard/unknown split. Residuals explicitly avoid claiming exhaustive Table 171 coverage or reserved-bit rejection.
priorities.residual: No additional gap established by the crosswalk; keep the recorded subtype-family boundary.

crosswalk_limits: Automated candidate classes are based on fields and exact issue markers, not semantic validation.
The primary /Subj universe is 360 issue IDs; the older early/late page inventories union to 356 because they omit four later markers in grouped subjects.
Primary source dispositions and test strength for all remaining IDs were not manually reread in this crosswalk.
